verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Teams supports rich app surfaces like tabs, message extensions, and message streaming, which imply structured interactive UI in chat, but the evidence never explicitly names Adaptive Cards, task modules/dialogs (modals), or button-based interactive cards that are core to this story. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Adaptive Cards/buttons, task-module modals, and hands-on or independent corroboration of building such interactive layouts.
